title: Paul Joanowits
content: Paul JoanowitsBashi-bazouks before a Gateway,oil on panel, 46 by 35cm., 18 by 14¾in.Paul Joanowits, also known as Pavle "Paja" Jovanović, was a Serbian realist painter who lived from 1859 to 1957. He painted more than 1,100 works during his lifetime.Paul Joanowits,Sword FightingHis painting "Sword Fighting" shows to men training a young boy how to wield a sword. Joanowits traveled to Morocco, Egypt, Greece, Turkey, Italy, and Spain and was inspired by Serbian history and everyday life of his people.
